title: release-publish
description: Publish one staged package to npm, throttled and retried so a lockstep release does not trip the registry's rate limit.

packageRoot.description: Staged package root, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the project root.

delay.description: Milliseconds to leave between two publishes across the whole release. Overridden by ORTHA_PUBLISH_DELAY.

retries.description: Extra attempts a rate-limited or transient failure gets. Overridden by ORTHA_PUBLISH_RETRIES.

retryBackoff.description: Backoff before the first retry, in milliseconds; doubles after that. Overridden by ORTHA_PUBLISH_RETRY_BACKOFF.

maxRetryBackoff.description: Ceiling for the doubling backoff, in milliseconds.

registry.description: Registry to publish to. Passed through by `nx release publish --registry`.

tag.description: dist-tag to publish under. Passed through by `nx release publish --tag`.

otp.description: One-time password for a registry that requires 2FA.

access.description: npm access level. The staged manifest already sets `publishConfig.access`.

firstRelease.description: Set by `nx release --first-release`; accepted for compatibility.

nxReleaseVersionData.description: Version data handed over by the `nx release version` step.
